thought: Hu Fucai (胡福才) is characterized as witty, flexible, and cunning (机智、灵活、狡黠), showing resourcefulness in battle and 'proud smiles' when cleverly using the environment. To distinguish him from the other four soldiers who have: penetrating eyes conveying deep thought, tightly pressed lips showing determination, severely cracked lips from deprivation, and prominent smile lines from habitual smiling, I need a unique permanent facial feature. I'll focus on sharp, distinctively arched eyebrows as his signature feature - this creates an inherently intelligent, cunning appearance that reflects his clever nature without relying on temporary expression. Combined with a slight but nimble build that suggests his flexibility and quick-thinking resourceful character.
distinctive_features: Sharp, distinctively arched eyebrows that create an intelligent, cunning appearance
